Chat Thread is the conversation around the composer: your messages, the model’s replies, and what you can do with them. It starts with your empty state and the composer centered, then docks the composer at the bottom once there are messages, without remounting it, so focus and draft text stay put.

Checkpoints are a navigation landmark of buttons named “Message 2: …”, and the current one has aria-current.

Checkpoints before your messages are restore points. Restore says exactly what goes, such as “Removes this message and 3 later messages, and reverts 3 files”, dims those messages while you decide, and lets you keep your code with Conversation only. The later messages fold away, your message goes back into the composer to edit, and a toast offers Undo.
